title: maestro_driver_timeout — Maestro Android driver did not start in time

keywords: did not start up in time

symptom: app flow (or a direct maestro test) stops with 'Maestro Android driver did not start up in time'. The same flow works at other times
cause: Emulator or host overload kept the on-device driver apps (dev.mobile.maestro, dev.mobile.maestro.test) from responding in time (reported 3 times, during builds)
fix: app flow already force-stops the driver apps and retries once before returning this code. Do not repeat the same command right away
Check whether heavy work such as a build (gradle · xcodebuild) is running, and retry after it ends
If it persists, ask the user about an emulator cold boot (emulator -avd <name> -no-snapshot-load)
